data.body: Every other AWS CLI call in this loop (`list-layer-versions`, `get-layer-version`, `add-layer-version-permission`, `get-layer-version-policy`) redirects stderr with `2>&1` and echoes the captured output to stderr before emitting the `::warning::`/`::error::` annotation, so a maintainer sees the actual AWS error. `publish-layer-version` is the only call missing `2>&1`, so on failure `$PUBLISH_RESULT` stays empty and only the generic "Failed to publish the layer in ${REGION}" warning is emitted — the real cause (throttling, quota limits, an unsupported `--compatible-runtimes java25` value, permission errors, etc.) is lost during an actual release, unlike every sibling failure path in this same script.
